body:
6.1.2 is a bit vague and should include examples.

Suggest change:

_6.1.2 | Verify that a list of context specific words are documented in order to prevent their use in passwords._ 

to:

_6.1.2 | Verify that a list of context specific words are documented in order to prevent their use in passwords. This includes rejecting passwords with organization names, product names, system identifiers, project codenames, department or role names and similar._

comments.body:
Minor change suggestion @jmanico:

"_Verify that a list of context specific words are documented in order to prevent their use in passwords. **The list could include permutations of** organization names, product names, system identifiers, project codenames, department or role names and similar."_

Version in PR:
> Verify that a list of context-specific words is documented in order to prevent their use in passwords. The list could include permutations of organization names, product names, system identifiers, project codenames, department or role names, and similar.
This works for me. Thank you. I still am not a big fan of the documentation elements, but will address that later. I'll approve the PR for now.

title: 6.1.2 / v5.0.be-1.2.5 is vague Verify that a list of context specific words are documented in order to prevent their use in passwords
